t: You're on Green Street, in Mayfair. People have built here since the mid-eighteenth century, though most of the buildings you see now date from the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. The street has had a number of notable residents, including members of the British aristocracy, the James Bond author Ian Fleming, and the Beatles. Two people were born here: Olivia Aldridge, an English charity worker who lived from 1848 to 1909, and Mary Eleanor Thursby, who was born in 1871.
